title: RunR runtime catalog, schema 1
description: The runtime manifests of a repository as one signed document: the single layer (media type application/vnd.runr.runtime-catalog.v1+json) of an OCI artifact of the same artifactType with an empty config, pushed with oras and signed with cosign (scripts/build-catalog.sh, scripts/push-signed.sh). RunR reads it as an oci-catalog runtime source and verifies the signature with the source's public key before it trusts a word of it. Each manifest is also valid against schema/runtime.schema.json (scripts/build-catalog.sh checks that); patches follow the patch feed v1 (schema/patch-feed.v1.json).

schema.description: The schema version of the document.

source.description: Where the manifests come from: the repository and the commit they were read at.

revision.description: The git commit (sha-1 or sha-256), or a label for a catalog built outside git.

runtimes.description: One entry per runtimes/<id>/runtime.yaml, ordered by path.

patches.description: Patches of this catalog's own runtimes (RunR ignores entries for other runtimes); the entries of the patch feed v1.

path.description: The manifest's path in the repository: <path>/<id>/runtime.yaml.

manifest.description: runtime.yaml as JSON, the @file references of build.files inlined; strings stay strings ("5.4", "2027-06-30").

files.description: Only for a runtime with a dockerfile version: the build context RunR uploads, every regular file of the runtime's directory but runtime.yaml (at most 50 files, 900 KB together).

time.description: A UTC time to the second.

level.description: How urgent the patch is: routine (rebuilds, upstream releases), security, critical, zero-day.

patch.description: A patch entry, as in the patch feed v1 (schema/patch-feed.v1.json, $defs/patch).

runtime.description: A runtime id of this catalog.

version.description: The version (floating tag) the patch belongs to (major.minor).

tag.description: The immutable patch tag: <full upstream version>-r<n>.

image.description: The image repository, without a tag.

digest.description: The digest of the patch's image (index or manifest).

reason.description: Why the patch exists, short, in English and Turkish.

cves.description: The vulnerabilities the patch fixes: CVE or GHSA ids.

upstream.description: The upstream release the image runs: "Lua 5.4.8".

deadline_at.description: When projects must run the patch (required for critical and zero-day).
